user.title: Connect to YouTrack
user.description: Enter the address of your YouTrack instance and a permanent token. Create a token under Profile > Account Security > New token.

data_description.url: The address you use to open YouTrack in the browser, including a possible context path.
data_description.api_token: The token needs access to the projects you want to add.

reauth_confirm.description: YouTrack rejected the stored token for {url}. Enter a new permanent token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure YouTrack
reconfigure.description: Change the connection settings. Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

error.invalid_url: This is not a valid http(s) address.

error.no_permission: The token is valid but has no permission to read data.

abort.already_configured: This YouTrack instance is already configured.

user.title: Add project
user.description: Choose the YouTrack project to add. Each project becomes its own device.

add_query.title: Add query sensor
add_query.description: The sensor shows how many issues of this project match the query. The query is limited to this project automatically. Use the YouTrack search syntax, for example `#Unresolved for: me`.

data_description.top: How many matching issues are listed in the sensor attributes.

edit_query_details.title: Edit query sensor
edit_query_details.description: The query is limited to this project automatically.

data_description.top: How many matching issues are listed in the sensor attributes.

watch_issues.title: Watch issues
watch_issues.description: Every unresolved issue that matches this search gets its own sensor (at most {max}). Use a tag or a list of issue ids, for example `tag: watch-me` or `issue id: DEMO-1, DEMO-2`. The search is limited to this project. Sensors of issues that are resolved or no longer match are removed. Leave empty to turn this off.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot load the project list from YouTrack.
abort.no_projects_available: There are no more projects to add.
abort.project_unavailable: This project is no longer available.

error.cannot_validate: The query could not be checked: {error}

create_issue.name: Create issue
create_issue.description: Creates an issue in the selected project and returns its ID and link.

type.name: Type
type.description: The issue type, for example Task. It must exist in the project.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: The priority, for example Major. It must exist in the project.

assignee.name: Assignee
assignee.description: The login of the user to assign.

add_comment.name: Add comment
add_comment.description: Adds a comment to an issue.

issue_id.name: Issue ID
issue_id.description: The ID of the issue, for example DEMO-12.

text.name: Comment
text.description: The comment text. Markdown is supported.

device_id.name: Project
device_id.description: Only needed with more than one YouTrack instance: any project of the instance.

transition.name: Change state
transition.description: Sets the state of an issue.

issue_id.name: Issue ID
issue_id.description: The ID of the issue, for example DEMO-12.

state.name: State
state.description: The new state, for example In Progress.

field.name: Field
field.description: The name of the state field if it is not State.

device_id.name: Project
device_id.description: Only needed with more than one YouTrack instance: any project of the instance.

assign.name: Assign issue
assign.description: Assigns an issue to a user, or removes the assignee with Unassigned.

issue_id.name: Issue ID
issue_id.description: The ID of the issue, for example DEMO-12.

assignee.name: Assignee
assignee.description: The login of the user, or Unassigned.

device_id.name: Project
device_id.description: Only needed with more than one YouTrack instance: any project of the instance.

log_work.name: Log work
log_work.description: Adds a work item with the time spent on an issue.

issue_id.name: Issue ID
issue_id.description: The ID of the issue, for example DEMO-12.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The time spent, for example 1h 30m. Units are w, d, h and m.

date.name: Date
date.description: When the work happened. Defaults to now.

work_type.name: Work type
work_type.description: The name of the work type, if your project uses them.

device_id.name: Project
device_id.description: Only needed with more than one YouTrack instance: any project of the instance.

search_articles.name: Search articles
search_articles.description: Searches the knowledge base and returns matching articles without their content.

query.name: Search
query.description: A YouTrack article search, for example a word from the title.

device_id.name: Project
device_id.description: Limit the search to one project. Without it, all projects of the instance are searched.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of articles to return.

get_article.name: Get article
get_article.description: Returns an article including its Markdown content.

article_id.name: Article ID
article_id.description: The ID of the article, for example DEMO-A-12.

device_id.name: Project
device_id.description: Only needed with more than one YouTrack instance: any project of the instance.

confirm.description: The project {project} of {instance} cannot be found any more. It was deleted, archived without access, or your token lost access to it. Its entities are not updated. Select **Submit** to remove the project from Home Assistant, or restore access in YouTrack and reload the integration.
